We look forward to welcoming you.

snippet.title: Khaadi Mardan | The Green Hub
snippet.description:
Introducing The Green Hub in Mardan, Pakistan’s first Net Zero Energy retail space. It is powered entirely by natural resources and is designed to generate more energy than it uses.
This space is built with 95% locally sourced materials, celebrating regional craftsmanship while reducing plastic waste and using natural cooling with minimal water. With 100% energy cost savings, we pass the benefit directly to you, making quality fabrics more affordable and accessible.
The Green Hub sets a new benchmark for sustainable retail. Mardan is just the beginning.
